card.name: Ends of medical terms before a pause
card.fires_on: The last piece of a medical term or abbreviation just before a bracket, comma, or sentence break, such as the G in CBG, macro in microscopic and macroscopic, or disease in anemia of chronic disease.

modes.label: End of condition name
modes.description: The last word of a condition or source name, followed by a section break or a for phrase.
